It's a place for scrubby pvp players who have no skills in CoD, PubG, Fortsh!te etc & definitely not Marathon! Far too dogsh!t for Marathon!

That IS a FACT.
 

So I have a solution for this game Raiders! ❤️

If you down &/or knockout a player - The Arc's aggro doubles on you and your team members for each crime/player killed.
You can't extract until there's 5 minutes remaining of the raid...
There's also a bounty on your heads now & every other PvE player gets a "Rat Purge Pass" & can slay the rats without compromising their aggression status!

Great game, not buggy on my end at all. Fun solo and with a group.

It was fun while leveling until you realize that the farther you get the worse the servers are. I was grinding and for 3 games straight was killed and looted by ambush players. I've lost everything (and I am still leveling). I have no weapons or resources to continue to level at where I am at now. I was able to get a Bettina back and level it to 3 and then got dropped the next game by another ambush player. There is no defense against those kinds of players and the dev's don't care or listen. I am happy to learn that it's broken only 150 hours in. good luck out there!

Game of the Year goes FLOP.
This game brought back gaming to many people but doesn't seem to care about the many issues that lie deep within it mechanics or code. The cheating is ridiculous, first it was the out of map spot on stella that took months for the devs to acknowledge and "remove" the issue. No. they removed the zip to the glitch but you could still access via snap hook, took another couple months to patch. Mind you myself and others did not receive a single kit back for dying to the exploiters.
Fast forward to today where the ESP cheats or aimbot and walls run rampant... yet the devs have yet to mention any plan besides longer bans... there are tiktok accounts exploiting how long it takes for them to get banned, some take a month and some never get banned..
The updates with the Arc, events and new map has been lacking and an utter failure.

I am not pleased to write this as I truly enjoyed and loved this game.
I do hope to see the devs take some serious action but until then I will be away and keeping this negative review in place.

I'm gonna rant a little here but this game does not deserve the mixed review. It's phenomenal. Best game i think we've seen in the passed view years with all the micro transaction pay to win slop. 

The biggest sentiment I've been personally seeing in the community or in reviews is how angry people get about pvp. "Embark needs to make a pve only mode". NO THEY DON'T. And frankly if they introduced a pve only mode, the same people saying they want a pve only mode would get bored and leave the game. Let's not forget that this game was supposed to be pve but the devs changed it to the state it is in now because pve only is boring and simply isn't fun for long periods of time. 

I'm a player that loves a bit of both. Does it suck losing loot? yes. Do i complain? no because THAT'S THE GAME I SIGNED UP FOR. PVE only mode would destroy this game entirely in my opinion. There's a certain thrill of keeping your head on a swivel knowing that someone can run up and kill you for your loot. if that goes away, this game just won't be fun any more

==== RANT OVER =====

Now that the rant is over i think there is a way that the devs could address this while still keeping the integrity of the current game lobby mechanics.

I think a cool way of combatting this PVP vs PVE fiasco is having some kind of hostility meter in your map or logbook that you can check once you load into a game. A spectrum from green to yellow to red. Green being friendly, red being hostile. Embark has all historical data on players and behaviours in their matches. They can perhaps analyze the players history for the past 20 or so games and take an average of all the players they put into match making to dictate what is displayed in this hostility meter. 

If all the players in your lobby have played the last 20 or so games friendly then the meter will be all the way in the green to give you a peace of mind. If most of the players in your lobby have been historically friendly but there are a few 'bad apples' in your match then the meter is half way between green and yellow. Just about half friendly and half more aggro players, the meter is smack dab in the middle at yellow, indicating that you should put your head on a swivel and prepare for the chance that a fight may break out. If the meter is all the way at the red, you are in a full on pvp lobby and you know what you're getting yourself into.

Fighting other raider and losing your sh*t sometimes is just part of the game. Please if anyone at Embark is reading this PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD DO NOT MAKE A PVE ONLY MODE.

Thank you for listening to my TED talk
